Worst part...in my move to be proactive, I had bought this filter before needing it. So, by the time I changed the filter in the fridge, the window to return it to Amazon had expired. SO DISAPPOINTED. Waste of money!

If you can, find the KENMORE brand ones. There are websites other than Amazon that sell them. DO NOT BUY THIS KNOCK-OFF!

I took the Refresh MWF out of the box, and replaced my GE MWF filter with the Refresh. It fit perfectly, turned perfectly with the same quiet grinding woosh of the real thing but....no water came out. Nothing. I reset the GE frig water filter two or three times but with no result. I filled the Refresh filter up with some water and tried the same. Nada. I replaced the old GE filter back and it worked perfectly. I received my new GE water filter and it installed perfectly. It's a new GE refrigerator and possibly GE figured out how to identify and reject generic filters like the Printer companies chip technology defeats generic ink cartridges? Either way I never squeezed and ounce of water out of it. Just another reason Amazon Prime is a blessing and worth the $99 fee. Returned it with no problem.
